## Classes

### CobblerXmlRpcClient

File: `e2e/fixtures/xmlrpc-client.ts`

Description: Minimal Node-side XML-RPC client talking to the same real cobblerd endpoint the browser under test hits via the /cobbler\_api proxy. Deliberately NOT the Angular CobblerApiService — that's an @Injectable requiring Angular's HttpClient DI context and can't run standalone in Playwright's Node process.

Properties:
- `client: xmlrpc.Client`
- `token: string | undefined`

Methods:
- `call(method: string, params: unknown[]): Promise<T>`
- `createItem(type: string, fields: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string>` — Creates an item directly via XML-RPC (new -\> modify each field -\> save), bypassing the UI.
- `getAutoinstallTemplates(): Promise<string[]>`
- `getItemHandle(type: string, name: string): Promise<string>`
- `getItemNames(type: string): Promise<string[]>`
- `login(username: string, password: string): Promise<string>`
- `modifyItem(type: string, handle: string, field: string, value: unknown): Promise<boolean>`
- `newItem(type: string): Promise<string>`
- `removeAutoinstallTemplate(filePath: string): Promise<boolean>` — Templates/Snippets aren't Item objects — they're plain file-content RPCs.
- `removeItem(type: string, name: string, recursive: unknown = false): Promise<boolean>`
- `requireToken(): string`
- `saveItem(type: string, handle: string): Promise<boolean>`

### DateFormatter

File: `projects/typescript-xmlrpc/src/lib/date_formatter.ts`

Description: The DateFormatter supports decoding from and encoding to ISO8601 formatted strings. Accepts formats with and without hyphen/colon separators and correctly parses zoning info.

Properties:
- `colons: unknown = true`
- `hyphens: unknown = false`
- `ISO8601: unknown = new RegExp( '([0-9]{4})([-]?([0-9]{2}))([-]?([0-9]{2}))(T([0-9]{2})(((:?([0-9]{2}))?((:?([0-9]{2}))?(.([0-9]+))?))?)(Z|([+-]([0-9]{2}(:?([0-9]{2}))?)))?)?', )` — Regular Expression that dissects ISO 8601 formatted strings into an array of parts.
- `local: unknown = true`
- `ms: unknown = false`
- `offset: unknown = false`

Methods:
- `decodeIso8601(time: string): Date` — Converts a date time stamp following the ISO8601 format to a JavaScript Date object.
- `encodeIso8601(date: Date): string` — Converts a JavaScript Date object to an ISO8601 timestamp.
- `formatCurrentOffset(d: Date): string` — Helper function to get the current timezone to default decoding to rather than UTC. (for backward compatibility)
- `getLocalDateParts(date: Date): unknown` — Helper function to get an array of zero-padded date parts, in the local time zone
- `getUTCDateParts(date: Date): unknown` — Helper function to get an array of zero-padded date parts, in UTC
- `zeroPad(digit: number, length: number): string` — Helper function to pad the digits with 0s to meet date formatting requirements.

### ItemCrudPage

File: `e2e/page-objects/item-crud.page.ts`

Description: Generic, config-driven page object covering the CRUD flow shared by every "standard" item type (distro/profile/system/repository/image/management-class/package/file/menu): overview list -\> create dialog -\> edit page -\> rename -\> delete. All of these types follow the identical dialog.open(XCreate)/isEditMode/mat-menu(Rename/Delete) pattern.

Methods:
- `create(fields: Record<string, string>): Promise<void>` — Opens the create dialog, fills the given fields, submits, and waits for the edit-page nav.
- `delete(name: string): Promise<void>`
- `edit(field: { label: string; value: string }): Promise<void>`
- `expectFieldValue(label: string, value: string): Promise<void>`

### ItemConfig

File: `e2e/item-configs/types.ts`

Properties:
- `createFields: function` — Required fields for the create dialog, keyed by formControlName. name is injected by the test.
- `editableField: { label: string; value: string }` — One field exercised in the edit-form persistence check, targeted by its text. Edit-page fields are rendered from a @for loop using interpolated formControlName="{{ ... }}" — Angular does NOT reflect interpolated attributes back into the DOM (only static, literal formControlName="x" attributes survive, as used in create dialogs), so getByLabel is the only selector that reliably works here — confirmed empirically against the live app.
- `label: string` — Human-readable label used in test titles.
- `overviewRoute: string`
- `requiresParent?: { type: string; formControlName: string }` — If set, a prerequisite object of this type must exist first (created via XML-RPC, not the UI).
- `type: string` — Route segment under /items/ .
- `xmlrpcType: string` — XML-RPC object type used in new\_ /modify\_ /save\_ /remove\_ /get\_ \_handle calls — NOT always the same as the route segment (e.g. route "repository" is XML-RPC "repo", route "management-class" is XML-RPC "mgmtclass").

Template, Snippet (file-content API, no Item object) and NetworkInterface (sub-resource of System, modified via modify\_system) are deliberately excluded — they get their own dedicated specs instead of this generic, config-driven one.
